themes.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no modification. Apple Siri color palette: #fbfbfd page background (luminance 251, qualifies for light register), #1d1d1f near-black text, transparent nav, gradient accent vocabulary (pink #ea3a8c, purple #bf5af2, indigo #5e5ce6, cyan #32ade6).

Twist A (font size scale shift ×1.15) + Twist B (letter-spacing injection 0.06em). All proprietary fonts (Avenir Next) replaced with Space Grotesk via get-fallback-font: geometric precision, cool temperature, light-palette match. h1: 65px → 74.75px, h2: 39px → 44.85px. Letter spacing 0.06em added to all heading CSS vars.

Twist C (easing curve swap): primary easing changed from cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) to ease-in-out across all transitions. Produces symmetrical, breathing motion quality — the system decelerates as carefully as it accelerates. All keyframes and scroll patterns retained from griting-opux.

Twist B (gap value scaling ×1.4): all columnGap and rowGap values scaled ×1.4. grid-1 gap: 40px → 56px, grid-2 gap: 36px → 50.4px, responsive breakpoint gaps scaled proportionally. Container max-width retained at 1530px from source.
Twist B (section-specific breathing room +32px): section paddingRight and paddingLeft each increased from 54px to 86px. All other spacing values retained verbatim from pale-engine source.

Twist A (hover transition speed snappier, −0.1s): all hover transition durations reduced from 0.45s to 0.35s across buttons, links, and navigation elements. Easing functions unchanged (cubic-bezier retained from still-voltage). No color values modified.

Twist D (letter spacing 0.08em on nav links): active-theory source had minimal geometry ({}) — functional nav structure scaffolded to match ghost-pill aesthetic from source's concept. Letter spacing 0.08em injected on typography. Frosted glass scroll state added to maintain tonal continuity with opaline palette.

Twist A (kinetic shift): the Typography System paragraph was rewritten to emphasize the mechanical precision and spatial consequences of the heading scale shift — treating the typeface as 'precision machinery: components with tolerances'. concept_by_video.md generated fresh with 3 video placements: hero-bg.mp4 (prism-light drift over white surface, 10s), product-ambient.mp4 (close-up product in use, 5s), surface-texture.mp4 (raking light on opaline material, 5s).

colorContrast.notes: navText (#1d1d1f, brightness 29) on transparent nav (treated as pageBackground #fbfbfd, brightness 251) — adequate contrast. bodyText (#1d1d1f) on pageBackground (#fbfbfd) — adequate contrast.

motionInteractionCoherence.notes: Hover transitions at 0.35s. Motion primary durations 0.2s–0.3s. Ratio 0.35/0.2 = 1.75× — well within 5× threshold.

navFontAvailability.notes: Nav typography set to 'inherit'. No unavailable font family referenced.
